summary_1line: Rama and Sita relax by the Mandakini until Lakshmana spots Bharata’s approaching army and angrily vows to destroy it, believing Bharata intends harm.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lakshmana stands high in a shala tree scanning the horizon as a vast army with elephants, chariots, and fluttering banners advances through rising dust.
Animals of the forest—elephants, deer, and buffalo—scatter in panic as the distant thunder of Bharata’s army rolls through the woods of Chitrakuta.
Furious Lakshmana, bow in hand and eyes blazing, vows before Rama to destroy Bharata and the approaching army.
